''See also: [[Ziel of the Wasteland Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Ziel is a horned individual from the [[Wasteland]] known for his reputation as a calculating opportunist who waits for advantageous moments to strike. He is associated with the [[Wasteland]], a region that serves as a defensive barrier between dragon territory and [[Akura clan|Akura]] lands, and he reportedly operates under the protection of the [[Beast King]]. Ziel utilizes a hammer in combat and follows the [[Path of the Wasteland]], which involves techniques using wind and sand. He is also linked to the [[Path of the Dawn Oath]], an offshoot of the [[Path of Last Oath|Path of the Last Oath]]. Once potentially a powerful practitioner such as an [[Archlord]] or Overlord, Ziel's spirit was severely damaged and tormented, leaving him with a fractured soul that makes using [[sacred arts]] difficult and painful. This damage has impacted his ability to hold items in his [[soulspace]] or maintain high-level techniques. Despite these struggles, he has demonstrated significant resilience and a drive to regain his former strength or achieve specific goals, such as destroying [[Eternity Incorporated]]. Throughout various journeys and conflicts, including those involving the [[Monarch]] [[Northstrider]] and the [[Dreadgods]], Ziel has displayed a weary, somewhat detached demeanor, often appearing older than his physical eighteen-year-old body suggests.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Ziel is a young-looking but haggard man with shaggy hair and emerald horns that glow faintly. He wears a tattered gray cloak, sometimes marked with dark spots, and black armored boots. His body has been ravaged by toxic green energy and bears scars from his [[Remnant]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A former genius who once gave up on himself, Ziel is known to wait on the sidelines for an advantage. He is a companion to [[Lindon]] and [[Orthos]], often assisting with instructions or reinforcing rooms with [[scripts]]. He is a chosen of the [[Wasteland|Wastelands]] and [[Northstrider]], tasked to solve crises with long-term solutions.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Ziel is a companion and group member to [[Lindon]], [[Yerin]], and [[Orthos]]. He was recruited by [[Eithan]], who also performed a Baptism on him, and he has an oath to [[Arelius family{{!}}House Arelius]] for life. Ziel was mutilated by the leader of the [[Stormcaller]] cult and is a defeated foe of the [[Sage of Calling Storms]]. Additionally, he represents [[Northstrider]] as their chosen and is a member of the [[Dawnwing Sect]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A [[Soulsmith]] and skilled scriptor, Ziel practices a variation of the [[Path of the Dawn Oath]] to forge emerald and silver runes into circles or rings. He utilizes the [[Enforcer technique]], specifically the [[The Stone Anchor|Stone Anchor]], to manage the weight of his massive hammer and maintain his footing. As the [[Shield Sage]], he can conjure force barriers, create massive [[steel]] shields across the sky, and use the [[Steel Dragon’s Mountain]] technique.}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|A member of the [[Dawnwing Sect]] and a chosen of [[Northstrider]], Ziel is a tournament combatant who wears a gray cloak and carries a massive two-handed warhammer.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c5">''Wintersteel'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c15">''Wintersteel'', chapter 15</ref> This practitioner of a variation of the [[Path of the Dawn Oath]] possesses short, faintly glowing green horns and displays [[Spiritual pressure|spiritual pressure]] more akin to a [[Truegold]] than an [[Underlord]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c5" /> As a skilled scriptor and [[Soulsmith]], Ziel utilizes the [[Enforcer technique]] alongside [[Forging]] techniques to create circles.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c5" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c15" /> Representing [[Northstrider]] in the [[Uncrowned King Tournament|Uncrowned tournament]], Ziel stands before their audience to compete for a blood [[Red madra|red madra]] [[Broken Crown]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c6">''Wintersteel'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c7">''Wintersteel'', chapter 7</ref> Despite [[Eithan]]'s ability to funnel [[advancement]] resources to them, Ziel had given up on himself and held a lifelong oath to [[Arelius family|House Arelius]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c11">''Wintersteel'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c15" /> After being eliminated from the matches, it was revealed that Ziel is a mystery who once suffered a spiritual injury following a brief rampage against [[Brother Aekin]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c16">''Wintersteel'', chapter 16</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c18">''Wintersteel'', chapter 18</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Northstrider representative}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Ziel of the [[Wasteland]] owns a [[cloud fortress]] situated next to [[Lindon]]'s, and he once stood beside him.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c4">''Bloodline'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c5">''Bloodline'', chapter 5</ref> A former [[Archlord]] who can fall asleep instantly by a pond, Ziel was recruited by [[Eithan]] and linked his fortress to [[Lindon]]'s during their approach.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c5" /><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c6">''Bloodline'', chapter 6</ref> After pushing over a tree with one hand, he shook his head in response to [[Eithan]]'s declaration.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c6" /> [[Lindon]] did not borrow Ziel's power, and the former leader of the [[Dawnwing Sect]] expressed his belief that anywhere would be better than their current location.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c8">''Bloodline'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c9">''Bloodline'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c10">''Bloodline'', chapter 10</ref> As a chosen of [[Northstrider]] and an [[Uncrowned]] of the [[Uncrowned King Tournament|Uncrowned King tournament]], Ziel represents both the [[Akura clan]] and the [[Sage of Twin Stars]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c10" /> Although he noted that a [[Dreadgod]] can eat entire mountains, his spirit is currently restricted and his strength has been reduced to that of a [[Jade]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c10" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Kazan clan evacuation}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|During the evacuation, Ziel traveled personally to visit other clans to provide assistance, though they were ultimately too far away to escape in time.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c12">''Bloodline'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c13">''Bloodline'', chapter 13</ref> It is possible that Ziel was responsible for bringing the [[Kazan clan]] members to this location, a situation that left [[Lindon]] uncertain of their actual status.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c15">''Bloodline'', chapter 15</ref> As a person [[Lindon]] and [[Yerin]] had been searching for, Ziel eventually reached the base of [[Mount Samara]] alongside the [[Kazan clan]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c16">''Bloodline'', chapter 16</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c17">''Bloodline'', chapter 17</ref> After a period of unnatural focus subsided, Ziel experienced fear and was notably absent from the [[cloudship]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c17" /><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c18">''Bloodline'', chapter 18</ref> Following a journey south via a [[Thousand-Mile Cloud]], Ziel began recovering from spiritual wounds through the benefits of the [[Pure Storm Baptism]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c19">''Bloodline'', chapter 19</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c21">''Bloodline'', chapter 21</ref> This Baptism was performed on Ziel by [[Eithan]] using [[soulfire]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c21" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Cloud fortress resident}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Ziel resides in a house aboard an unnamed [[cloud fortress]], where he is currently in a state of recovery.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c2">''Reaper'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c4">''Reaper'', chapter 4</ref> Having undergone the [[Pure Storm Baptism]], his spirit has been uncomfortable for years, and he is also recovering from the [[suppression field]] surrounding [[Sacred Valley]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c4" /> After fighting a [[Dreadgod]], he utilizes foundational [[scripts]], protective [[scripts]], and an [[encryption circle]] to secure his cloudbase.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c4" /> Despite having a long-dry heart and using a [[void key]] to store his belongings, he is sought out by the [[Sect of Twin Stars]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c4" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c7">''Reaper'', chapter 7</ref> Known as the Master of the [[training hall|Training Hall]], he was among those who entered [[Lindon]]'s room.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c7" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c9">''Reaper'', chapter 9</ref> He moved by hopping on discs of [[Forged]] runes, identified a [[Death aura|death aura]], and his body shines emerald when he employs his hammer.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c11">''Reaper'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c12">''Reaper'', chapter 12</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Labyrinth combatant}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|While present in [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]], Ziel demonstrated the ability to scrape runes into blood.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c12" /> He utilized a hammer and conjured a force barrier, though his gray cloak was marked by dark spots.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c13">''Reaper'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c14">''Reaper'', chapter 14</ref> His body is thrice-forged in [[soulfire]], and he was seen using [[scripts]] to seal a tunnel while suggesting that [[Ruler techniques]] could address the [[death-madra|death madra]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c14" /> In combat, Ziel wielded a hammer driven by [[Forged]] [[Script|script]] to match against [[Lindon]]'s trident.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c16">''Reaper'', chapter 16</ref> After suffering burns across the left half of his body, he moved weakly against a wall before losing consciousness.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c17">''Reaper'', chapter 17</ref> [[Lindon]] attempted to pick him up, and later Ziel was seen looking down on the trench.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c17" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c18">''Reaper'', chapter 18</ref> After snoring in a hallway, Ziel inquired about what [[Lindon]] would name the hammer.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c19">''Reaper'', chapter 19</ref> Though not yet a [[Sage]], he employed the [[steel|Steel]] [[dragons|Dragon]]'s Mountain technique and utilized emerald runes.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c20">''Reaper'', chapter 20</ref> His [[Path]] consists of permutations of a single [[Forger technique]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c20" /> A flyer wearing a gray cloak, Ziel was present with [[Lindon]], [[Eithan]], [[Yerin]], [[Orthos]], and [[Little Blue]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c24">''Reaper'', chapter 24</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c25">''Reaper'', chapter 25</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Near Windfall}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Located near [[Windfall]], Ziel is an [[Archlord]] who previously led the [[Dawnwing Sect]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c3">''Dreadgod'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c6">''Dreadgod'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c10">''Dreadgod'', chapter 10</ref> The son of an advanced [[sacred artist]] and scriptor, Ziel bonded his father's [[Remnant]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c6" /> As a companion to [[Lindon]] and [[Orthos]], he often sits on nearby rocks and uses [[spiritual perception]] to extend into the ground.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c7">''Dreadgod'', chapter 7</ref> In combat, Ziel utilizes a massive silver shield and a blocky hammer, which he keeps in a [[void key]] and sometimes holds upside-down.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c5">''Dreadgod'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c7" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c10" /> He employs emerald [[scripts]] to surround his limbs and weapons, using forged [[scripts]] to manipulate momentum or launch himself.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c13">''Dreadgod'', chapter 13</ref> While his [[madra]] is relatively weak compared to the [[Rune Queen]]'s, his [[Path]] is similar to hers.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c13" /> After fleeing down a dark hallway, Ziel ended up slumped and buried under the wreckage of [[Shatterspine Castle]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c18">''Dreadgod'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c19">''Dreadgod'', chapter 19</ref> During these events, he observed the [[Remnant]] and assisted [[Lindon]] by providing instructions on how to operate an ancient [[Script|script]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c19" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c23">''Dreadgod'', chapter 23</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Lindon's group}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Ziel is a member of [[Lindon]]'s group, though [[Lindon]] worries that Ziel might only be following him due to his and [[Yerin]]'s influence.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c3">''Waybound'', chapter 3</ref> While seated in a [[cycling]] position before the [[The Paths of Heaven|Paths of Heaven]], Ziel operated the Array.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c4">''Waybound'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c7">''Waybound'', chapter 7</ref> Currently pushing toward peak [[Archlord]], Ziel is being prepared by [[Lindon]] to withstand hits from [[Dreadgods]] and [[Monarchs]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c7" /> His technical skills include laying [[scripts]] in the [[sparring hall]] and steering a [[Grand Oath Array]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c12">''Waybound'', chapter 12</ref> During combat, Ziel used his [[madra]] to intercept stray lightning bolts for [[Yerin]] and utilized silver runes to form a protective bubble.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c13">''Waybound'', chapter 13</ref> Although he has spoken to [[Little Blue]] and possesses [[Archlord treasures]], Ziel had not yet completed his [[Sage]] insight.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c13" /> Capable of using both silver and green runes, he is at the peak of his realm and close to [[Sage]], with the ability to forge runes in a circle around himself.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c13" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c14">''Waybound'', chapter 14</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Battle against Sage}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|During the battle against the [[Sage of Calling Storms]], Ziel was a defeated foe who utilized [[force madra]] and the [[The Stone Anchor|Stone Anchor]] to maintain his physical form.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c14" /> Despite possessing an [[Archlord revelation]] and the ability to manifest a massive [[steel]] shield across the sky, his core was entirely empty during this conflict.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c14" /> As a newly advanced [[Sage]] with unstable [[Authority|authority]] and a near-empty core, Ziel fought in the battle and witnessed [[Yerin]] kill the [[Herald]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c15">''Waybound'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c16">''Waybound'', chapter 16</ref> Having departed from [[Lindon]]'s group one week earlier, he managed to escape by cutting through [[Way|the Way]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c17">''Waybound'', chapter 17</ref> While carrying a stowed [[Grand Oath Array]], Ziel also recently awakened to the [[Shield Icon]] and consumed a recovery [[elixirs|elixir]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c18">''Waybound'', chapter 18</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The battle}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|While traveling to the battle, the [[Shield Sage]] Ziel fought through [[lightning-dragons]] and a hostile storm using a large [[steel]] shield for defense.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19">''Waybound'', chapter 19</ref> Utilizing a [[Path]] suited for defense, he employed the [[Path of the Dawn Oath]] to spin emerald runes into circles and used the [[The Stone Anchor|Stone Anchor]] [[Enforcer technique]] to maintain his footing.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19" /> Feeling a furious will from both himself and the [[Dreadgod]], Ziel hovered in the sky to hurl techniques at the [[Weeping Dragon]] while using the [[Oracle Sage]]'s blessing to observe the conflict.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20">''Waybound'', chapter 20</ref> He used [[scripts]] to forge rings of emerald runes, even feeling an arrow come to a stop within one of his circles.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20" /> After [[Malice]] shifted her === {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Monarch power}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Possessing the power of a [[Monarch]], Ziel was previously a [[Truegold]] in [[Ghostwater]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c29" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c30">''Waybound'', chapter 30</ref> He can focus [[vital aura]] by forging a circle and utilizes combat techniques that fall like hundreds of hammers.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c30" /> After refusing to enter the [[portal]], Ziel inquired whether [[Eithan]] could provide assistance to [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c31">''Waybound'', chapter 31</ref> He is a figure of interest for students in the [[training hall|Training Hall]] and has the ability to transport himself inside vessels.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c32">''Waybound'', chapter 32</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c36">''Waybound'', chapter 36</ref> Ziel wears black, armored boots.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c36" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Reaper Division}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Chosen to resolve crises through long-term solutions, Ziel is a member of the [[Reaper Division]] who would have protected people while fulfilling his objectives.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c6">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c11">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 11</ref> While traveling under a provided cover identity, the [[Sage]] utilizes the [[Path of the Dawn Oath]] and can employ illusions.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c11" /> Despite having a limited amount of [[madra]] compared to his full power, he channels force using runes and [[script-circle|script-circles]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c11" /> Having endured the agony of a ravaged spirit, Ziel scavenged technology from local garbage to create a makeshift shield.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c11" /> While returning home from a mission, he was covered in greenish blood from a split worm in the Void.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 12</ref>}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] has some [[Authority|authority]] as a [[Sage]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c11" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] uses the [[Path of the Dawn Oath]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c11" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] uses runes and [[script-circle|script-circles]] to channel force.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c11" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] is returning home from a mission.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] was covered in greenish blood from a split worm in the Void.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] stated that [[Iteration]] names are determined by a committee of [[Ghosts]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Yerin]] performed [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] work to prevent people from believing she was a spider goddess.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c13">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 13</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>
